Used to be kinda cool. They used to offer a couple decent features for free before greed took over but it’s never been close to a “fish brain”. For starters, the bite time is so bad it’s actually comical. Most people photograph the fish they catch and then actually log it several hours later back at home. They literally just average out the upload times and claim that’s when the fish are biting which couldn’t be any more untrue. To think even close to half of the uploaded fish were caught where they are posted is quite laughable as well, no one is going to tag exactly where they caught the largest fish of their life. They don’t have close to all the rods and reels, even some very popular models. As far as lures, they don’t have a decent percentage of them. I’m not sure how they trick folks into paying for this service but you will gain much more knowledge watching YouTube and the weather.
